# An invoice whose `payment:` names a credit card as the account the money
# reached.
#
# A liability is a bill payment account — the company card settles a bill and
# leaves the card issuer owed instead. An invoice is the other direction:
# money owed *to* the company arriving, and a liability is not where it
# arrives. So the widening is one-sided, and this pins the side that did not
# move.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming the account.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_invoice_bad_debt.py.
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Credit Card
	type: Credit Card
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C010"
	name: "Test Customer"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-CARD"
	customer_id: "C010"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Services"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-CARD"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-06-01
		amount: 100
		account: "Liabilities:Credit Card"
		memo: "illegal: invoice payment routed to a liability"
